name: Mazthoril
summary: In central Winterspring, Mazthoril shelters the blue dragonflight in a vast cavern. Its ice tunnels are guarded by dragonkin, spell-wielding wyrms, and arcane sentries, and lead to the aerie of Haleh, the reclusive blue matriarch.

sections.title: A Bastion of Blue Dragons
sections.body:
Just south of Everlook, Mazthoril is cut into the frozen mountains. A large brood lives within and answers to Malygos, the Spell-Weaver. Dragonkin patrol the cavern and the nearby crags, among them Spellmaw, Azurous, and General Colbatann.

Elite guardians keep watch over the inner caverns. The dragonspawn are attuned to raw arcane energy, so any journey inside is perilous without serious preparation.

sections.title: The Teleportation Rune and the Matriarch
sections.body:
Deep in Mazthoril's frozen labyrinth, the drakes Manaclaw and Scryer watch a mystical rune set in the floor. Step on it, and it carries travelers to an isolated mountain aerie above the cavern.

Haleh lives there, a blue dragon matriarch who keeps the guise of a high elf. Cautious toward mortals, she holds deep lore about draconic lineage and has a vital part in unlocking the hidden ward that protects Onyxia's Lair.

aliases: who is the boss of mazthoril
faq.answer: Haleh, a powerful blue dragon matriarch, oversees Mazthoril. She lives in an isolated aerie high above the cavern, reached through a magical rune deep in the tunnels. When greeting mortal visitors, she appears as a high elven woman.

faq.q: Why are blue dragons living in Winterspring?
aliases: why are there dragons in winterspring
faq.answer: The titans charged the blue dragonflight with guarding Azeroth's arcane magic. Its members watch lingering fonts of ancient energy across the world. Around Lake Kel'Theril, Winterspring holds remnants of the Highborne's ancient civilization, making Mazthoril a natural stronghold for the flight's sentinels in Kalimdor.

Fight through the dragonkin to the back of Mazthoril's inner cavern. Between the drakes Manaclaw and Scryer, a glowing arcane rune marks the floor. Step into its center to reach Haleh's high perch atop the mountain.

faq.q: What role does Mazthoril play in entering Onyxia's Lair?
faq.answer: Alliance heroes investigating the protections around Onyxia's Lair are sent to consult Haleh. Her part in that journey is revealed in a hidden passage.

angles.text: Alliance heroes investigating the black dragonflight seek Haleh, the matriarch, in Mazthoril.
As a mage, you may find Mazthoril compelling. Malygos's realm teems with creatures saturated in pure arcane power, drawing any scholar of the arcane.
